Letters

Vote for Bill Reichle

Sarah Pearson and Evan Seevak · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Dear Piedmont Neighbors,

Ballots will arrive soon, and we have an opportunity to elect outstanding community members to our Piedmont City Council.

One of your three votes should be for Bill Reichle.

Bill has a deep appreciation for Piedmont. He has lived in Piedmont for 26 years; his wife and daughters went through the Piedmont schools. Bill served on the board of the Piedmont Education Foundation, Camp Augusta, and Piedmont Soccer Club.

Bill has a wealth of experience navigating complex situations. He worked as an administrator at UC Berkeley for 18 years, listening to stakeholders and finding solutions to longstanding issues.

Bill takes initiative and gets things done. Bill’s priorities for City Council are public safety, fiscal discipline, and community engagement. We are so fortunate that Bill wants to devote his next chapter to serving Piedmont. Bill will work tirelessly to improve our beloved community.

In a town of smart people, it’s helpful to have leaders who are good listeners, thoughtful, and creative problem solvers. Bill’s ability to listen, to work well with others and his dedication make him an unusually effective leader.

Please join us in casting an enthusiastic and appreciative YES vote for Bill Reichle.

Sincerely, Sarah Pearson & Evan Seevak 147 Arbor Drive, Piedmont
